claims.claim: Frontal rows carry low-amplitude fast activity, posterior rows moderate-amplitude alpha (A-P gradient)
claims.test: iteration 1b PDR call: posterior alpha peak above aperiodic fit, and above frontal
claims.result: PASS - posterior 31.4 dB, frontal 0.0 dB; 11.75 Hz, confirmed by counting 12 peaks between the 1 s rules on a 3x crop

claims.claim: Mu: arch-shaped alpha-band waves over the sensorimotor (central) rows, blocked by movement
claims.test: alpha-peak height on F3-C3/C3-P3/F4-C4/C4-P4 exceeds the posterior rows; PDR not called
